audit.whatIsWrong: The chart disagreed with the already-applied mirror at four rows: win[0]/win[1]/win[2] read Skill/Yorick/Yorick and win[4] read 'Skill'.
audit.why: The mirror audit (darius__yorick) flipped its chart as one atomic group across both layers to Darius / Darius / Darius / Yorick / Yorick / Yorick / Yorick. Levels 1-3 are Darius's because Decimate's blade edge heals him and out-damages anything Yorick has before Dark Procession is reliably online; from 4 onward the cage plus the ghoul army takes over, and level 6 goes to Yorick because Maiden and Mist Walkers are bodies the Guillotine window has to chew through first.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 4 flipped across both layers as one atomic pair-matched group, ratings brought into line with the mirror's (Darius 7/10 early reads as 3/10 for you; level 6 and 2+ items read 7/10; first item 6/10). whys[0], whys[1], whys[2], whys[4], early, mid and spikes[1].text rewritten so the prose no longer calls levels 1-3 'even' or level 6 'a coin-flip'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' (sequencingCues 0). Apprehend is named as the tracked cooldown in twelve fields with no number attached.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 — one of the longest laning cooldowns in the game and the single largest window Yorick gets. Decimate is 9s at rank 1 and Noxian Guillotine 120s. Saying 'bait the pull' without the 26 is advice with no teeth.
audit.corrected: The 26s appears in dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns and early, each phrased as the window it opens; Decimate's 9s and Guillotine's 120s added to early and spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Apprehend's passive was never mentioned anywhere, while report[8].t builds Plated Steelcaps and dosFull/dontsFull say nothing about it.
audit.why: Riot's text: Apprehend 'passively caus[es] his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor'. That is a standing tax on every armour item you buy against him, and it is separate from Noxian Guillotine's true damage — two independent reasons that stacking armour is not the answer here (missingInteractions rule 'resistances-invalidated').
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now states that Apprehend shreds armour passively, so Steelcaps buy less than the player expects.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t mentions Executioner's Calling but no lane text ever says when the heal matters or which ability it comes from.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule 'needs-antiheal': Decimate heals Darius per enemy champion hit BY THE BLADE — the outer edge. Every extended trade he wins early is that heal, so Grievous Wounds timing is the early-game decision, not a late-game one.
audit.corrected: early now ends on buying Grievous Wounds early with the Decimate heal named as the reason; wants.you[1] repurposed to the same lever.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are a respectful farm lane — Darius wants to walk up and land the outer edge of his Q for the heal and big damage, so you sit just behind the minions and last-hit with Q. Don't give him a free Apprehend pull by hugging the wall; his level-1-2 damage is real if he lands full Q. Soak XP, keep your E for the moment your W comes online.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 belong to Darius — he walks up to land the blade edge of Decimate (9s) for the heal and the big damage, so sit behind the minions and last-hit with Last Rites. Apprehend is 26s at rank 1: once he spends it you have half a minute of safety. Buy Grievous Wounds early, because that Decimate heal is what wins him every long trade.

edits.before: At 3 the lane tilts to you: drop W Dark Procession to cage Darius, E Mourning Mist for the slow, and hit him where he can't land the healing outer-ring of his Q. Level 6 is a coin-flip all-in — his Guillotine executes low targets, but your ghouls and Maiden body-block his pull-Q spin, so trade only with your army up. Every caged trade where he misses outer-Q is free damage that stacks toward your first-item spike.
edits.after: From 4 the lane tilts to you: drop Dark Procession (20s) to cage Darius, Mourning Mist for the slow and armour shred, and stand where only the handle of Decimate can reach you. Level 6 is yours — Guillotine still executes, but ghouls and Maiden are bodies his pull-Q combo has to chew through first, so fight with the army up. Every caged trade where he misses the blade is free damage toward your first item.

edits.before: Both ults are all-in tools — his Noxian Guillotine executes, but your R Maiden plus ghouls means his pull-Q-W combo has to chew through bodies first, so you survive the dunk window.
edits.after: Level 6 tips to you — Noxian Guillotine (120s) hits harder per Hemorrhage stack, but Maiden and ghouls force his pull-Q-W combo to chew through bodies first, so the dunk lands late.

notes: I followed the mirror rather than this packet on the chart. The two disagree: the darius__yorick packet gave Darius/Darius/Darius/Yorick/Yorick/Yorick/Yorick and that chart has already been applied to the Darius page as an atomic group, while the yorick__darius packet here gives Skill/Skill/Skill/Yorick/Skill/Yorick/Yorick. Matching the mirror is what keeps the two directions from rendering different answers to 'who wins Level 1', and the mirror reading is also the one the kit supports — Decimate's blade heal is a real early-lane edge that 'even' does not describe. The seven prose rewrites are part of that same change and should land with the chart rows. Note that the enemy Q wording on this page ('outer-ring', 'outer-Q') is correct: Riot's text says enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle, and only blade hits heal him.
